- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, lines ~15820-15843 (the stored-status rewrite path) and the caller in the current-wave reconcile loop, lines ~20237-20250 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `_heal_rejected_merged_state` fails to rewrite the state file (`jq … > STATE_FILE.tmp && mv STATE_FILE.tmp STATE_FILE` returns non-zero), the function returns 0 without setting `MERGED_HEAL_WAVE_HOLD=true` and without modifying `MERGED_HEAL_LABELS_JSON`.
  WHY: The stored `status: "merged"` and the `ai:merged` label remain in place, so `check-wave-status` can return "merged" and the wave can advance on the rejected merge.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the `state_write_failed` else branch (~lines 15826-15843) and its single caller in the current-wave reconcile loop | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `state_write_failed` branch logs `MERGED_STATE_STALE … action=retry why=state_write_failed` and returns 0, while the caller's wave-hold logic only inspects `MERGED_HEAL_LABELS_JSON` and the original LABELS_JSON.
  WHY: Both label values are equal on this path and retain `ai:merged`, so the wave-hold asymmetry treats the state-write failure as a no-op and leaks the rejected merge into the wave status.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR adds a new repository variable `ENABLE_MERGED_STATE_HEAL` (default `true`) that operators can set to `false` to disable the heal of stale merged state. The new variable is documented in the main variables table (line 200) and in the deprecated/compatibility section (line 2030) of README.md, but the project's append-only compact configuration table at the bottom of the variables section (around line 1794, with the explicit "append new env vars to the BOTTOM of this table" anchor) does not list it. Operators using the compact reference will not discover this rollback switch.
  Expected change site: README.md at the bottom of the compact configuration table (around line 1839, immediately before any anchor that ends the table)
  Evidence of absence: The diff's three README.md hunks are at lines 198-205 (main table), 2028-2034 (deprecated section), and 2263-2269 (note 13c). No hunk touches lines 1790-1840, and the compact table is not in the diff. The variable's row is present in two other README.md tables and absent from the compact reference.
